title: Student admin (School DB)
brief: Browser admin for the school student database: list, create, edit and delete students. Stack is FastAPI + BeerCSS + HTMX, server-rendered with HTMX partial swaps, used by teachers on desktop and tablet. Three directions differ in layout strategy, not color.

artboards.title: Dense admin table
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest to scan and manage many students on desktop, with filters and inline row actions; colder and the weakest on tablets and phones, and it hides how much a student record matters

artboards.title: Student cards grid
artboards.tradeoff: Friendliest and touch-first, with per-course chips and per-student cards that read well on tablets; slow to scan past a few dozen students and impossible to compare column by column

artboards.title: Master-detail split
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest for repeated editing because the list context never disappears and edits happen in place; needs a wide viewport and is the most complex layout to make responsive
